spec.productObjective: Ship Atrium remote browser: dial worker topology, Playwright automation, Express middleware, React viewer, internal worker HTTP for cookies and storage_state, URL allowlist, reconnect replay, adaptive JPEG, optional TLS on dial, and documented sprint artifacts.
userStories: As a backend engineer, I can mount Express middleware with session lifecycle, control handoff, navigate with allowlist, and cookie extraction so my app can orchestrate human auth safely.
As a frontend engineer, I can embed RemoteBrowser and reconnect with replayed server JSON so users recover from network blips.
As a platform engineer, I can tune worker memory caps and JPEG quality under backpressure so fleet capacity stays predictable.
constraints: MIT public source; secrets only via env.
Cookies and storage_state only on host-authenticated HTTP, never on viewer WebSocket.
assumptions: Node 20 plus pnpm; Playwright Chromium for non-dry workers.
spec.architectureNotes: API dials worker WS for frames; worker exposes internal HTTP for navigate, cookies, storage_state; session replay ring buffers JSON on API relay; adaptive screencast restarts CDP screencast when quality knobs change.
spec.dependencyNotes: Express 4, ws 8, Playwright 1.49, Zod 3, React 18, Vitest 3, ESLint 9, Prettier 3.
nonGoals: BullMQ multi-worker fleet allocator in this milestone (documented for next phase).
testStrategyBullets: pnpm test runs Vitest workspace for protocol, server, worker, react.
pnpm lint runs ESLint plus Prettier check plus recursive tsc typecheck.
spec.definitionOfDone: Sprint 1-3 contract items implemented or explicitly deferred in sprint docs with evidence; CI green on lint test build.

completedWork: Sprint 1 HTTP surface: sessions, control, navigate, cookies, storage-state, health probes.
Sprint 1 viewer relay with JSON replay buffer for reconnect.
Sprint 2 worker internal HTTP plus shared Playwright session registry.
Sprint 3 adaptive JPEG under WebSocket backpressure plus optional process memory eviction hook.
Sprint 3 optional workerTls passed to upstream WebSocket dial.
pendingWork: BullMQ create-session queue plus multi-worker Lua allocator.
Credential redaction in structured logs for password focus (worker detection path).
mTLS client certs for worker dial beyond rejectUnauthorized toggle.
decisions: Use in-memory session store by default; Redis persistence flag reserved on AtriumConfig without hard dependency in repo tests.
risks: Fleet BullMQ rollout needs staging soak before production traffic.
progress.nextStep: Prototype BullMQ session-create flow behind feature flag and wire Redis capacity script.
